## 7. Relationship Classification
Grouping rules applied:
1. Same UNIQUE physical host wall
2. Overlapping or nearly identical finite raw intervals within 5px tolerance
3. Shared or adjacent frame features via sourceSegmentIds/sourceFeatureIds
4. Shared jamb, wall-gap, or frame-bay evidence
5. Compatible wall-normal position
6. No fatal negative evidence
7. No competing host relationship

Only SAME_OPENING_* relationships formed groups.
PANEL_OR_FRAME_VARIANT did not join because no supported parent opening existed.
ADJACENT_SEPARATE_OPENING remained separate.
No UNRESOLVED_RELATIONSHIP groups remain.
